actions.description: Add a video to a YouTube playlist
actions.name: add-playlist-item

playlistId.description: The ID of the playlist to add the video to. Example: "PLxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"

videoId.description: The YouTube video ID to add to the playlist. Example: "dQw4w9WgXcQ"

position.description: The position to insert the video into the playlist (0-based). If not specified, the video is added to the end.

actions.description: Reply to an existing YouTube comment
actions.name: create-comment-reply

parentId.description: The ID of the parent comment to reply to. Example: "UgyYYtDkvwfR2g4Y8HZ4AaABAg"

textOriginal.description: The original text of the reply. Example: "Thanks for watching!"

actions.description: Create a top-level comment on a YouTube video or channel thread.
actions.name: create-comment

videoId.description: The ID of the video to comment on. Example: "dQw4w9WgXcQ"

channelId.description: The ID of the channel that owns the video. Example: "UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw"

text.description: The text content of the comment. Example: "Great video!"

actions.description: Create a YouTube playlist for the authenticated channel.
actions.name: create-playlist

privacyStatus.description: The privacy status of the playlist.

actions.description: Delete a YouTube comment by comment ID
actions.name: delete-comment

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to delete. Example: "UgyR8T-2e8gRcv1o0zN4AaABAg"

actions.description: Remove an item from a YouTube playlist
actions.name: delete-playlist-item

playlistItemId.description: The ID of the playlist item to delete. Example: "PL1234567890abcdefABCDEF1234567890abcdefAB"

success.description: Whether the playlist item was successfully deleted

actions.description: Delete a YouTube playlist by playlist ID
actions.name: delete-playlist

playlistId.description: The YouTube playlist ID to delete. Example: "PLxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"

actions.description: Delete a YouTube video owned by the authenticated channel.
actions.name: delete-video

videoId.description: The ID of the video to delete. Example: "dQw4w9WgXcQ"

actions.description: Retrieve YouTube channel details by ID, handle, username, or mine
actions.name: get-channel

actions.description: Retrieve a YouTube comment by comment ID.
actions.name: get-comment

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to retrieve. Example: "UgxT9K7pHq8QfC2z3t4"

actions.description: Retrieve a YouTube playlist by playlist ID.
actions.name: get-playlist

playlistId.description: The ID of the YouTube playlist to retrieve. Example: "PLxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"

actions.description: Retrieve a YouTube video by video ID
actions.name: get-video

actions.description: List caption tracks for a YouTube video.
actions.name: list-captions

videoId.description: The YouTube video ID of the video for which to return caption tracks. Example: "dQw4w9WgXcQ"

nextPageToken.description: The token for the next page of results.

actions.description: List playlists for a YouTube channel
actions.name: list-channel-playlists

maxResults.description: Maximum number of playlists to return (1-50). Default: 5

pageToken.description: Pagination token for the next page of results

actions.description: List YouTube comment threads for a video or channel.
actions.name: list-comment-threads

videoId.description: The video ID to retrieve comment threads for. Example: "dQw4w9WgXcQ"

allThreadsRelatedToChannelId.description: The channel ID to retrieve all comment threads for.

pageToken.description: The token for the next page of results.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Default: 20.

order.description: Order of comment threads. time (default) or relevance.

textFormat.description: Format of comments. html (default) or plainText.

actions.description: List items in a YouTube playlist
actions.name: list-playlist-items

playlistId.description: The ID of the YouTube playlist to list items from. Example: "PLBCF2DAC6FFB574DE"

maxResults.description: The maximum number of items to return (1-50, default 50).

cursor.description: Pagination token from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The unique ID of the playlist item.

playlistId.description: The ID of the playlist this item belongs to.

videoId.description: The ID of the video in this playlist item.

position.description: The position of the item in the playlist (0-indexed).

publishedAt.description: The date and time the item was added to the playlist.

channelId.description: The ID of the channel that owns the playlist.

channelTitle.description: The title of the channel that owns the playlist.

videoOwnerChannelId.description: The ID of the channel that uploaded the video.

videoOwnerChannelTitle.description: The title of the channel that uploaded the video.

privacyStatus.description: The privacy status of the video (public, unlisted, private).

videoPublishedAt.description: The date and time the video was published.

nextCursor.description: Token for the next page of results. Omit if no more results.

resultsPerPage.description: Number of results returned per page.

actions.description: List uploaded videos for a channel using its uploads playlist.
actions.name: list-uploaded-videos

channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID. If omitted, uses the authenticated user's channel ("mine"). Example: "UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw"

cursor.description: Page token from a previous response next_cursor to fetch the next page of results.

actions.description: Update the text of a YouTube comment.
actions.name: update-comment

id.description: The ID of the comment to update. Example: "UgzDE2pQ6kCHY1EaXcJ4AaABAg"

textOriginal.description: The new text content for the comment.

actions.description: Update a playlist item's metadata or position.
actions.name: update-playlist-item

actions.description: Update a YouTube playlist's metadata or privacy state
actions.name: update-playlist

id.description: The ID of the playlist to update. Example: "PLBCF2DAC6FFB6DE8"

privacyStatus.description: The privacy status of the playlist.

actions.description: Update YouTube video metadata for an owned video.
actions.name: update-video

id.description: The ID of the video to update. Example: "dQw4w9WgXcQ"

categoryId.description: The category ID for the video.

defaultLanguage.description: The default language of the video.

privacyStatus.description: The privacy status of the video.

embeddable.description: Whether the video can be embedded.

publicStatsViewable.description: Whether the public can view video statistics.

publishAt.description: Scheduled publish time (ISO 8601). Requires privacyStatus to be private.

selfDeclaredMadeForKids.description: Whether the video is self-declared as made for kids.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: Whether the video contains synthetic media.

localizations.description: Localized titles and descriptions by language code.

recordingDate.description: The date the video was recorded (ISO 8601).

syncs.description: Sync caption track metadata for YouTube videos in scope
syncs.name: caption-tracks

id.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the caption track

video_id.description: The ID of the video associated with the caption track

last_updated.description: The date and time when the caption track was last updated in ISO 8601 format

track_kind.description: The caption track type: ASR, forced, or standard

language.description: The language of the caption track as a BCP-47 language tag

name.description: The name of the caption track visible to users during playback

audio_track_type.description: The type of audio track: commentary, descriptive, primary, or unknown

is_cc.description: Whether the track contains closed captions for the deaf and hard of hearing

is_large.description: Whether the caption track uses large text for the vision-impaired

is_easy_reader.description: Whether the caption track is formatted for easy reader at third-grade level

is_draft.description: Whether the caption track is a draft and not publicly visible

is_auto_synced.description: Whether YouTube synchronized the caption track to the audio track

status.description: The caption track status: failed, serving, or syncing

failure_reason.description: The reason YouTube failed to process the caption track

syncs.description: Sync playlists for YouTube channels in scope
syncs.name: channel-playlists

id.description: The ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the playlist

channelId.description: The ID of the channel that owns the playlist

channelTitle.description: The channel title of the channel that owns the playlist

privacyStatus.description: The playlist privacy status: private, public, or unlisted

itemCount.description: The number of videos in the playlist

publishedAt.description: The date and time that the playlist was created

thumbnailUrl.description: URL of the default thumbnail for the playlist

syncs.description: Sync one or more YouTube channels in scope
syncs.name: channels

syncs.description: Sync comment threads for YouTube videos or channels in scope
syncs.name: comment-threads

syncs.description: Sync items from YouTube playlists in scope
syncs.name: playlist-items

syncs.description: Sync uploaded videos for YouTube channels in scope
syncs.name: uploaded-videos
